title: Xish's Pack
description: This is just a sideproject im working on
body:
![image](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1323984828957458532/1493593039417901197/minecraft_title.png?ex=69df886a&is=69de36ea&hm=1c9706373b04c61ae39223fd19d1a427c18733f4dd65786e0336fa4984c5e980&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=600&height=98)

Xish's Pack is a work-in-progress resource pack that gives Minecraft’s vanilla textures a complete visual overhaul. The goal is to refresh and enhance every texture _(and a few models)_ - from more detailed dirt and grass to better wood and other building materials.

This pack aims to keep the classic Minecraft style while adding a more modern, immersive, and polished look.
Perfect for players who want a refreshed yet familiar experience.

## Status: 
Work in progress - not done yet - every nature related texture will eventually be remade.
